description: Designed an efficient global state architecture with Context API and custom hooks, cutting unnecessary renders.
Built unit and integration test suites with Jest, raising system reliability by 15%.
Optimized the CI/CD pipeline for safer, more consistent deployments.
Reduced bug occurrence by 20% by writing style guides and institutionalizing code reviews.
Improved the end-user experience by shrinking the application bundle by 25%.
Led a dynamic social module in React.js that let 2,000+ users interact through achievements, comments and reactions, driving engagement on the platform.
Cut load times by 30% by optimizing client-side rendering and refactoring backend logic (Spring Java).
Optimized the digital badge exchange system, improving response speed by 25% for a smooth, uninterrupted experience.
Modernized the legacy platform to Next.js, applying SSR and SSG strategies to improve loading and SEO.
Designed a reactive component library to improve interface maintainability and fluidity.
Co-led workflow re-engineering, saving 20% in operational review time.

choppi.title: Choppi | Full-Stack Marketplace E-commerce
choppi.description: End-to-end marketplace e-commerce platform with a RESTful API in NestJS and a Next.js web app, simulating a real multi-store market.
choppi.fullDescription:
Highlights:
- Complete full-stack solution: from the database to the user interface.
- Working admin panel: protected interface for CRUD operations on stores and products.
- Advanced shopping cart: localStorage persistence with real-time price and stock recalculation.
- Secure authentication and authorization (RBAC): JWT-based flow with roles (Admin/User) and HttpOnly cookies.

Technical architecture:
1. Backend (NestJS): modular API with TypeORM (PostgreSQL), Passport.js (JWT, bcrypt) and automatic Swagger docs.
2. Frontend (Next.js): App Router with SSR/CSR, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui, React Context state and form validation with React Hook Form and Zod. Uses a proxy pattern in API Routes for secure communication with the backend.

workspot.title: WORKSPOT | Freelancer Ecosystem Platform
workspot.description: Workspot is a high-performance SPA that centralizes the workflow between employers and talent. It mirrors an enterprise software architecture, prioritizing modularity and complex business logic.
workspot.fullDescription:
Multi-role architecture: granular permissions for Admins, Employers and Freelancers with dynamic dashboards.

Complex user flows: a 10-step wizard with advanced state handling for publishing projects.

Advanced interactivity: direct chat, real-time proposal management and a notification center.

academic-react.title: Academic Management App
academic-react.description: A complete web app for academic management that centralizes an institution's operations. Admins, directors, teachers and students interact with the system according to their roles and permissions.
academic-react.fullDescription:
Main features:
Full CRUD for students and staff, academic programs and subjects, classrooms, courses and schedules, payment concepts, pre-enrollments and payments.
Role-based access control (RBAC): views and actions are restricted by the authenticated user's role.
Reusable UI: generic components such as GenericTable and FormModal, plus a custom toast notification system.

Implementation and architecture:
Built on Next.js and TypeScript with the App Router.
Client-side data architecture: a localStorage persistence layer abstracted behind custom React hooks (useStudents, useCourses, usePrograms…) in hooks/useDataStorage.ts. Each hook loads data on mount, exposes state and mutators (addStudent, updateStudent, deleteStudent) and syncs every change back to localStorage.

octo-condo.title: Octo-Condo: Full-Stack Condominium Management
octo-condo.description: Octo-Condo is a client-server solution that automates condominium administration, made of a NestJS backend (octo-condo-api-engine) and a web interface (octo-condo-manager).
octo-condo.fullDescription:
Backend (octo-condo-api-engine):
Centralized business logic: automates monthly fee calculation, prorating common expenses across units by share and assigning private expenses.
Secure REST API: JWT authentication and roles (ADMIN, OWNER).
Dynamic PDF generation: payment receipts and detailed reports rendered from HTML templates with Puppeteer.
External services: real-time exchange rates (e.g. BCV) to show amounts in USD and Bs.

Frontend (octo-condo-manager):
Admin panel: record expenses, generate the whole condominium's fees in one click, validate payments and manage residents.
Owner portal: secure access to account statements, fee breakdowns and PDF receipts.

medisync.title: MediSync | Medical & Emergency Management System
medisync.description: Omnichannel health platform connecting patients and doctors: web scheduling for appointments and availability, plus a cross-platform mobile app with an emergency panic button.
medisync.fullDescription:
Main features:
- Omnichannel ecosystem: an admin/doctor web panel and a patient-facing mobile app.
- Doctor portal: manage calendars, availability, appointments and consultation history.
- Emergency alert (panic button): patients request immediate assistance with one tap.
- Smart scheduling: find specialists, check real-time availability and book without friction.

Technical architecture:
1. Backend (NestJS): RESTful API on PostgreSQL via TypeORM, handling schedule overlaps and JWT auth.
2. Web frontend (Next.js): React and Tailwind CSS dashboards for doctors and admins.
3. Mobile app (Flutter): iOS/Android app in Dart consuming the same API, with native services for the emergency button.
